product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice Stage Wash 360W LED DMX Moving Head RGBW Stage Light with Zoom
product.description: Is it a spot light or a wash light? You decide. This thirty‑six 10‑watt LED moving head stage light is ready for any medium to large stage. Four color, RGBW LEDs and a 10° ~ 50° zoom will give you a huge amount of flexibility when you need to illuminate your stage. Super‑fast servo motors and 16‑bit fine tuners direct light where you want when, you want. If programming is not your speed, then take it out of DMX mode and activate the auto programs or sound active mode with internal mic. With one unit serving as the master, up to 32 additional units can slaved together for an incredible light show all night long.                              Features:                            Uses thirty‑six (36) 10‑watt 4‑in‑1 RGBW LEDs        8 built‑in programs        12‑channel and 16‑channel DMX control modes        540° of pan movement, 240° of tilt movement        Variable beam angle from 10° to 50°        Reversible Pan and Tilt control for inverted or mirrored operation        Touch screen menu and controls        Accepts 110 ~ 245 VAC, 50/60 Hz input power                                                                                                                                                                        Support Files:        User's Manual (Mar 7, 2016)          Monoprice™, Stage Right™, the Stage Right logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
